-- One valueStep per step, where the reference's arrows and wheel move half the bar -- (UIPanelTemplates.xml:137/149, UIPanelTemplates.lua:150-157). -- Soundless: the reference plays UChatScrollButton on an arrow click, never on the wheel. function BenillaScrollBar_Step(scrollBar, dir) local step = scrollBar:GetValueStep() if step <= 0 then step = 1 end scrollBar:SetValue(scrollBar:GetValue() + dir * step) end
-- Greys each arrow at its end of the range (reference: ScrollFrame_OnScrollRangeChanged). function BenillaScrollBar_UpdateArrows(scrollBar) local minV, maxV = scrollBar:GetMinMaxValues() local val = scrollBar:GetValue() local up = getglobal(scrollBar:GetName() .. "ScrollUpButton") local down = getglobal(scrollBar:GetName() .. "ScrollDownButton") if val <= minV then up:Disable() else up:Enable() end if val >= maxV then down:Disable() else down:Enable() end end
-- ReputationFrame's hang, 8 left, 21 above, 20 below (ReputationFrame.xml:573-599 against -- UIPanelTemplates.xml:166-181). Lazy: the bar does not exist at the trough's OnLoad. function BenillaScrollTrough_Seat(trough, scrollBar) if trough.seated then return end trough.seated = true trough:ClearAllPoints() trough:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", scrollBar, "TOPLEFT", -8, 21) trough:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", scrollBar, "BOTTOMRIGHT", 7, -20) end
-- Show and hide a bar only through here, so its `<barname>Trough` follows. function BenillaScrollBar_SetShown(scrollBar, shown) local trough = getglobal(scrollBar:GetName() .. "Trough") if trough then BenillaScrollTrough_Seat(trough, scrollBar) end if shown then scrollBar:Show() if trough then trough:Show() end else scrollBar:Hide() if trough then trough:Hide() end end end
-- For a stock `FauxScrollFrameTemplate` frame; call after `FauxScrollFrame_Update`. function BenillaScrollTrough_Follow(scrollFrameName) local sf = getglobal(scrollFrameName) if not sf then return end local bar = getglobal(scrollFrameName .. "ScrollBar") if not bar then return end local trough = getglobal(bar:GetName() .. "Trough") if not trough then return end BenillaScrollTrough_Seat(trough, bar) if sf:IsShown() then trough:Show() else trough:Hide() end end
-- One row per wheel notch (+1 up), from the owner window's OnMouseWheel; the reference's -- `ScrollFrameTemplate_OnMouseWheel` moves half the bar. function BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(frame, delta) local scrollBar = getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "ScrollBar") BenillaScrollBar_Step(scrollBar, -delta) end
-- ══════════════════════════ The real-scroll kit ══════════════════════════════════════════ -- Shaped on UIPanelTemplates.xml:166-211: the bar is the `Slider` child `$parentBar`. BENILLA_SCROLL_STEP = 20 -- px per arrow click or wheel notch BENILLA_SCROLL_PAD = 20 -- px of room below the child's last element
-- The loop back through SyncBar ends in one hop: Slider:SetValue ignores an equal value. function BenillaScrollBar_OnValueChanged(bar, value) bar:GetParent():SetVerticalScroll(value) BenillaScrollBar_UpdateArrows(bar) end
-- The range the bar follows: the engine's, the reference's union of the child's whole -- subtree, unless the frame measures its own content (`sf.contentRange`). function BenillaScroll_Range(sf) if sf.contentRange then return sf.contentRange(sf) end return sf:GetVerticalScrollRange() end
-- Hides the bar when the content fits, a range under a whole unit: the reference's -- `ScrollFrame_OnScrollRangeChanged` tests `floor(scrollrange) == 0` -- (UIPanelTemplates.lua:265). function BenillaScroll_SyncBar(sf) local bar = getglobal(sf:GetName() .. "Bar") if not bar then return end local range = BenillaScroll_Range(sf) bar:SetValueStep(BENILLA_SCROLL_STEP) bar:SetMinMaxValues(0, range) bar:SetValue(sf:GetVerticalScroll()) BenillaScrollBar_UpdateArrows(bar) BenillaScrollBar_SetShown(bar, floor(range) ~= 0) end
-- Clamped here: SetVerticalScroll stores any value, as the reference's does. function BenillaScroll_Step(sf, delta) local target = sf:GetVerticalScroll() + delta local range = BenillaScroll_Range(sf) if target > range then target = range end if target < 0 then target = 0 end sf:SetVerticalScroll(target) BenillaScroll_SyncBar(sf) end
-- The wheel's delta is +1 per notch up, and up scrolls toward the top. function BenillaScroll_OnMouseWheel(sf, delta) BenillaScroll_Step(sf, -delta * BENILLA_SCROLL_STEP) end
-- Nil if hidden, a blank FontString, or not laid out yet. function BenillaScroll_WidgetBottom(w) if not w then return nil end if w.IsShown then if not w:IsShown() then return nil end elseif w.GetText then local t = w:GetText() if not t or t == "" then return nil end end return w:GetBottom() end
-- Rects resolve after Lua runs, so owners re-run this from OnUpdate; it writes only on a -- real change, since SetHeight invalidates layout. function BenillaScroll_ResizeChild(scrollName, widgets) local sf = getglobal(scrollName) -- Not a derived name: the reference pairs `<X>ScrollFrame` with `<X>ScrollChildFrame`. local child = sf:GetScrollChild() if not child then return false end local top = child:GetTop() if not top then return false end local bottom = nil for i = 1, table.getn(widgets) do local b = BenillaScroll_WidgetBottom(getglobal(widgets[i])) if b and (not bottom or b < bottom) then bottom = b end end local height = 1 if bottom then height = (top - bottom) + BENILLA_SCROLL_PAD end if height < 1 then height = 1 end if math.abs(child:GetHeight() - height) < 1 then return false end child:SetHeight(height) sf:UpdateScrollChildRect() return true end
